name: I Love Lucy
hook: The 1950s sitcom that invented the rerun — Lucy, Ricky, Fred and Ethel are still the template.

facts.label: I Love Lucy (1951)
facts.statement: I Love Lucy premiered on CBS in 1951 and was billed as television's first smash-hit situation comedy; it won the Best Situation Comedy Emmy in 1952 and 1953.

facts.label: Lucille Ball
facts.statement: Lucille Ball starred as redheaded Lucy Ricardo, and her real-life son Desi Arnaz Jr. was born on January 19, 1953 — the same night Lucy gave birth on the show.

facts.label: Desi Arnaz
facts.statement: Cuban-born conga drummer Desi Arnaz played Ricky Ricardo and was Lucille Ball's real-life husband; a 1956 episode took the Ricardos to Cuba, his birthplace.

facts.label: Desilu
facts.statement: Desilu was the production company formed to make the show, its name combining Desi and Lucy; it went public in 1958.

facts.label: Fred and Ethel Mertz
facts.statement: William Frawley and Vivian Vance played the Ricardos' landlords, Fred and Ethel Mertz; Fred was the bald one and Ethel was Lucy's partner in mischief.

facts.label: "pregnant"
facts.statement: CBS would not let the show say "pregnant," so a 1952 episode was titled "Lucy Is Enceinte," using the French word instead.
